quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. It is illegal and unsafe to turn right here.

questions.question: What message appears on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Look for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are near a school zone or crossing. Stay alert and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that a side road will intersect ahead.

questions.question: This white sign means you should not pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction here.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn right or left on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn right or left on a red light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that turning right or left when the traffic light is red is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that making a U-turn is not allowed.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards or special conditions ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a two-way road where traffic moves in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road has a reverse curve. The road will curve to the right and then curve to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you are not allowed to drive. You may see it on one-way streets or if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: This orange diamond-shaped warning sign alerts you to an upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. If a pedestrian is in a crosswalk, you must stop and wait until they finish crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let traffic crossing your path pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic crossing your path pass before you go.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross before you proceed. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has curves and turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that wet roads are slippery and harder to drive on safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign means you are in or near a school zone. Watch for children and follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending. Merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending. Merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the number of lanes will decrease ahead. Traffic should merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead. Keep to the right of the median.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is allowed only on a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a yellow-green background. These warn of upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It appears as a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs tell drivers what is not allowed. This sign means you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about services for drivers. These signs show where to find rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other services.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign facing you, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you a flagger is coming. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright jackets. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic and let workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
Traffic is moving both ways on this road.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is moving both ways on this road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left turns are not allowed here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns are not allowed here.
questions.explanation: Red circles with a line through them mean the action is not allowed. This sign means no left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles, animals, and people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign at intersections where there is heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Slow down to 35 mph or less before you reach the upcoming curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to 35 mph or less before you reach the upcoming curve.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed for the upcoming curve.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance warning sign shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this example, it is 12 feet 6 inches.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange warning signs are used in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you about an upcoming curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Sharp left and right turns ahead.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road has several curves ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only" below it, you should:

options.text: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Travel in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must drive in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you must go left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; the road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign that you must obey. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that vehicles may be joining your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This traffic law sign means you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangle signs pointing down mean yield. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Stop at the marked line if you must stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is joining ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look all around before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead of turn signals. A left arm held straight out signals a left turn.

questions.question: What should you do at this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop for any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: You may turn left only on a green arrow.
You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
You must wait for a solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass first. Then you can follow the sign's directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if cars are coming toward you.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop where you can see oncoming traffic. Then go only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop as quickly as you can.
Stop and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downhill slope ahead. It may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic merging from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let other traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign says right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you about a traffic light intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending. You will soon see two-way traffic ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of slippery road conditions. Wet pavement is dangerous and causes longer stopping distances. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location. It is illegal and unsafe to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black lettering means no passing zone. You will see this sign at the start of an area where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to road conditions. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then curves left. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right because of construction.
The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and get ready for a sharp turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes direction or becomes narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road changes direction or becomes narrower.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will change direction or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or on approaches to narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions you may not see right away. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed to avoid accidents and brake problems.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you:

options.text: Must treat it like a stop sign.
Cannot go until it turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians before going.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the right lane is ending. Get ready for traffic to merge from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if you can. This gives merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Keep going at your normal speed.
Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you an intersection is coming. Be ready for other traffic or to turn.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you:

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should be ready to stop.
Will always stop at the railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must go through the intersection at this speed.
The highest speed allowed is 55 mph in good conditions.
You must not go slower than this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed allowed is 55 mph in good conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed limit for this road. You can drive slower if needed, but you cannot drive faster than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You can turn left or drive straight in this lane.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
If you are driving slower than other traffic, stay in the right lane.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are driving slower than other traffic, stay in the right lane.
questions.explanation: This sign means keep the left lane open for passing and faster traffic when you can.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, what should you do?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign shows you are near a school. Watch carefully and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is ahead.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is near schools to warn drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: This sign is a:
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop at a yield sign.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal means one is coming. Be ready to respond to the traffic signal.

questions.question: This sign shows a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Keep the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if a train is near.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if a train is near.
questions.explanation: At this crossing, slow down, look both ways, and listen for trains. Be ready to stop if a train is nearby. Never try to outrun a train.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on vehicles that move slowly.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before you merge.
Always come to a complete stop.
Signal and enter traffic at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let traffic on the main road pass before you merge.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for other vehicles to pass before entering. You do not need a complete stop if no other cars are coming, but always slow down and proceed with caution.
